## Purpose

Post-REDCap work turns authorised source releases into approved public metric
datasets and reports. Stata computes and controls analytical publication;
Quarto presents approved public outputs; GitHub deploys the static Info-Hub.

Human analytical review, disclosure review, approval and publication are
separate actions. Private data, staging packages, logs, credentials and review
evidence remain outside Git.

## Choose the route

| Required product | Controlled route | Technical instructions |
|---|---|---|
| Approved CVD event metric release | [CVD event release workflow](cvd-events-workflow.qmd): six steps | [CVD event workflow](../../technical/workflows/cvd-events/overview.qmd) |
| Approved CVD mortality metric release | [CVD mortality release workflow](mortality-workflow.qmd): six steps | [Mortality workflow](../../technical/workflows/mortality/overview.qmd) |
| Rolling three-month CVD update | [Reporting workflows](reporting-workflows.qmd): one controlled build from approved releases | [Rolling update](../../technical/workflows/reporting/rolling-update.qmd) |
| Annual CVD report | [Reporting workflows](reporting-workflows.qmd): build, approve and publish | [Annual report](../../technical/workflows/reporting/annual-report.qmd) |
| One-off CVD report | [Reporting workflows](reporting-workflows.qmd): prepare, approve and publish | [One-off report](../../technical/workflows/reporting/one-off-report.qmd) |

Public CVD tables, dashboards and downloads are presentation products derived
from approved public metric releases. They do not establish separate analytical
workflows.

## Common control sequence

1. Confirm authority, reporting period and source identity.
2. Build the private candidate through the relevant Stata workflow.
3. Review analytical validity and disclosure safety.
4. Record approval against the exact candidate where the workflow requires it.
5. Publish only the approved payload.
6. Render and inspect the affected Quarto presentation.
7. Deploy only reviewed, public-safe website source and approved public assets.

The rolling update is the limited exception to a second report-level approval:
its builder consumes already-approved event and mortality releases and permits
only the authorised display transformations in the controlled template.

## Corrections

Never edit a generated dataset, table, chart or report manually. Correct the
source data or version-controlled code, assign the required new version, and
rerun from the earliest affected step. See [Correct a release](../release/correct-release.qmd).
